name: 48433 · Flushing, MI
findings: ZIP 48433 (Flushing) has 72 nonprofit organizations. 44 of them (61%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 38 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (36% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 48433 (Flushing) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
